proposed_scope: Only retry_malformed_proc_numbers error predicate: ParseIntError OR std::io::Error raw errno equals SRCH, and Instant::now()<original deadline. Retry entire reap_one_complete_scan; no identity None/terminal shortcut.
static_verdict: ACCEPTABLE_WITH_EXACT_TYPE_AND_ORIGINAL_DEADLINE_CONDITIONS; actual changed source and compile/native tests not certified
reasoning: read_bounded returns std::io::Error from actual /proc file open/read; an opened owned child stat FD can legally return ESRCH after its owner actually reaps it, as the independent root-owned control records.

child_ids lists children across all calling-process threads; a child owned by another collector can disappear after enumeration and before this collector has enough identity bytes to classify it as foreign. Retrying a complete ownership scan permits reclassification without pretending any child ended.

reap_one_complete_scan reacquires and verifies leader pid/parent/group and then retains starttime comparison; the original unreaped leader is NOWAIT-pinned until descendant cleanup returns, before child.wait_timeout.
Retriable std::io ESRCH never returns Ok by itself. Any partial scan result is discarded, and a fresh scan must pass owner identity, pidfd/child wait and no-found-descendant completion logic.

Direct rustix::io::Errno SRCH from pidfd_open/waitid is converted directly into anyhow::Error, not through std::io::Error; Rust Into conversions do not transitively choose Errno->io::Error->anyhow. It therefore must not be retried by this predicate.

Existing pidfd SRCH path still requires a second identity read. A live/reused PID rejects; only real absent old identity keeps found=true to force a full subsequent scan. If the second proc read itself produces std::io ESRCH, only a new complete scan is allowed.
CHILD/PERM/other errno, UTF8/shape/size/deadline/identity errors stay fail-closed. Bare ownership-changed and missing-owner errors are not std::io SRCH.

Existing original deadline is passed unchanged to every scan; sleep is bounded by remaining time, and expired error is returned. MAX_PROC_BYTES1MiB, CLEANUP_BUDGET1s and original3s nested-family calls are unchanged by predicate alone.
required_controls_for_root_actual_source: Retain all existing malformed-number, wrong-owner, expired and concurrency assertions.
Actual opened child stat FD alive->owner wait0->read std::io ESRCH->whole-scan retry must be RED before predicate and qualify only via a fresh scan after fix.
Synthetic direct rustix::Errno::SRCH must execute one scan and fail, showing no implicit std::io widening.
std::io permission/other raw errno must execute one scan and fail.
Expired std::io ESRCH must fail after one scan without acquiring a fresh deadline.
Source/native source pin and tests after modification remain required; no historicCI failure closed by static review.
